topic: Verification of ISS-2449 patch — §6.14 ps-tldr appended three-coexisting-ΔZ-formulas sentence
change_summary: Decider patched ISS-2449 (c1 h2 minor TLDR fix): appended one sentence to §6.14 ps-tldr naming three coexisting ΔZ formulas (BOU, monitor.py KAPPA-squared, inject_ai_layer.py) and their incompatible Ebro 2026 magnitudes (~-10.7, ~-28.9, ~-8.4 nT). Verifying patch closed the hole cleanly and did not introduce new inconsistencies.
our_argument_summary: §6.14 elevates a single cross-eclipse/cross-instrument κ ratio into a structural model parameter; applying κ to other documented eclipses predicts SG pulses that did not occur. The h3 'Internal formula heterogeneity' adds that the dome's own code produces three (or four, including W004) mutually incompatible ΔZ magnitudes for Ebro 2026 from the same underlying physics.

dome_code_analysis.calculation_pipeline: monitor.py line 512: ecm_eclipse = -18.22 * 0.95 * 1.672 ≈ -28.9 nT. -18.22 itself is KAPPA-applied (-10.9 BOU * 1.672 κ). The trailing *1.672 reapplies κ in the FSF slot.
dome_code_analysis.hardcoded_vs_computed: Hardcoded constants in monitor.py; published per-station BOU is one number, monitor.py runtime is another, inject_ai_layer.py is a third, W004 path is a fourth.
dome_code_analysis.escape_clauses: No adaptive tolerance; each formula publishes a fixed magnitude.
dome_code_analysis.code_discrepancies: None new on this patch. ISS-2447 (open, moderate) still tracks the older sections using -29.1 nT vs §6.14's -28.9 nT for monitor.py — the new TLDR propagates the -28.9 figure, mildly reinforcing the cross-section asymmetry until ISS-2447 is closed.

code_analysis_tags.monitoring_evidence: monitor.py line 512 uses hardcoded KAPPA=1.672 and a hardcoded -18.22 baseline; no external fetch for the ΔZ prediction itself.
code_analysis_tags.relabels_standard_evidence: Internal formula heterogeneity is a self-contradiction argument, not a relabeling of standard physics.
code_analysis_tags.post_hoc_evidence: Argument concerns dome-internal inconsistency, not adoption of pre-existing measurements.
code_analysis_tags.derives_from_dome_evidence: All four magnitudes (~-10.7, ~-28.9, ~-8.4, ~-21.7 nT) are derived from the dome's own published formulas and constants — they disagree with each other, not with standard physics.

holes_found.description: TLDR introduces a third site for the -28.9 nT vs -29.1 nT cross-section conflict that ISS-2447 already tracks. The newly-added sentence names ~-28.9 nT for the monitor.py KAPPA-squared formula. Older sections (§4.4, §6.10, §9.1) attribute -29.1 nT to monitor.py. ISS-2447 (open, moderate) is already on the docket to reconcile this; the patch does not create a new issue, it propagates the §6.14-h3 figure into the TLDR layer where it is now more reader-visible. No new action needed beyond closing ISS-2447 in the normal queue.
holes_found.recommendation: Leave the new TLDR sentence as written. When ISS-2447 lands (recommendation: option A — patch older sections to -28.9), the TLDR remains consistent automatically. If decider chooses option B (-29.1 everywhere), this TLDR sentence will also need a one-character edit. Note ISS-2447 as the canonical fix-track; no separate issue.

kernel_of_truth.description: The TLDR-append discipline is structurally right: §6.14's TLDR is the first thing readers see, and the heterogeneity argument is now load-bearing for the section's overall claim that κ is internally inconsistent (data/sections.json:part6.html — TLDR text 2026-06-01). Without the appended sentence, a reader expanding the section was hit by the heterogeneity h3 as a surprise; with it, the TLDR signals the structure before they expand.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: The TLDR fix is execution-quality only — it surfaces an argument the body already makes (data/sections.json:part6.html h3 'Internal formula heterogeneity — three coexisting dome ΔZ recipes'). It does NOT validate the underlying critique, which is itself sound (four mutually incompatible dome-internal magnitudes for the same Ebro 2026 ΔZ prediction).

deeper_analysis: Patch verification: ISS-2449 was a minor TLDR-completeness fix flagged in c1 h2. The decider's resolution ('Appended sentence to §6.14 TLDR naming the three coexisting ΔZ formulas (BOU, monitor.py KAPPA-squared, inject_ai_layer.py) and their incompatible Ebro 2026 magnitudes (~-10.7, ~-28.9, ~-8.4 nT)') matches the patched text verbatim modulo punctuation. The TLDR sentence preserves the body's three-formula framing without overclaiming (it does not say 'four', staying aligned with the h3 heading 'three coexisting dome ΔZ recipes' even though W004 is named as a fourth inside the body). Counter-argument the dome defender could try: 'The TLDR overstates by calling these formulas coexisting — they might be intentional alternative parameterizations, not bugs.' Rebuttal: the body documents that monitor.py applies κ twice (once in the baseline, once in the FSF slot, against the dome's own published FSF of 1.029) — that is not an alternative parameterization, it is double-counting. The TLDR's word 'incompatible' is correct because the magnitudes differ by 3-4× from each other, not by rounding. ISS-2447 (cross-section -28.9 vs -29.1) is the only adjacent open thread, and the patch propagates -28.9 (which curmudgeon's c1 recommended as option A — the formula-correct value). Net assessment: ISS-2449 is fully closed; no new holes introduced.
